summary.text: Tom Mannion is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 1 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and software engineer, he said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he is running to continue keeping government out of people's lives and wallets.

paragraphs.text: Tom Mannion was born in Lynn, Massachusetts, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2004 to 2008.
He earned a high school diploma from Westfield High School and a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from the University of Massachusetts Lowell in 2012.
His career experience includes working as a software engineer.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Mannion said he moved to New Hampshire in 2020 and described himself as a Marine Corps infantry veteran and software engineer.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Mannion listed his priorities as removing as much government as possible from residents' lives, continuing to lower taxes, and passing a measure called Defend the Guard.
He named health freedom, taxation, veterans issues and foreign policy as the public policy areas he is most passionate about.
